g.text: To make it easier to compare and explain the multiple regression equation
(or multiple regression model), the raw scores above are converted into
ZŶ = β₁z₁ + β₂z₂ + β₃z₃ + β₄z₄ + β₅z₅
In the standardised score multiple regression equation, ZŶ represents the
standardised score for the criterion variable, which is the teaching
The five beta coefficients β₁, β₂, β₃, β₄ and β₅ represent the standardised
regression coefficients for the z₁, z₂, z₃, z₄ and z₅ predictor variables.
By standardising the equation, comparison of the contributions of the
predictor variables to the criterion variable becomes valid and meaningful.
